Section I — Timekeeping
A — Shift Management
Change schedule type per employee. Ad hoc via email.
B — Holiday Setup
Custom holidays and adjustments. Ad hoc via email.
C — Leave Credits Validation
Annual Q4 reconciliation of filed leaves vs. credits.
D — Attendance Validation (Current Attendance Validation)
Review current payroll attendance. Report to client.
E — Variance Analysis
Compare attendance from previous months. Report to client.
F — Validation of Disputes
Review disputes from past 3 months. Report to client.
Section II — Employee Record Management
A — Adding New Employees
Onboard new hires. Report to client.
B — Updating Employee Profiles
Status changes, salary increases. Ad hoc.
C — Payroll ID Sync (PYO)
Update Payroll ID in Sprout HR. Ad hoc.
